name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.01: Shinjuku Chuuou Kouen Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.01 新宿中央公園殺人事件
source:
Police inspector Kumano Sanzou has asked Jinguuji Saburou for help when the strangled body of a popular hostess was found in Shinjuku Central Park. Jinguuji accepts the case, but first he needs to find witnesses that are willing to speak out. 

[Edited from [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#1]Pixelmenu[/url]]
translation:
新宿中央公园发现一具颇有人气的女公关尸体，死因是遭人勒颈。警部熊野参造为此向神宫寺三郎求助。神宫寺接下案件，但首先必须找到愿意开口作证的目击者。

[改编自[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#1]Pixelmenu[/url]]
